name: shipguard
description: AI-assisted code audit, process behavior simulation, and visual E2E review for changed code.

interface.shortDescription: Audit changed code, simulate behavior, and review visual tests
interface.longDescription: ShipGuard bundles focused skills for static code audit, diff-scoped process behavior simulation, browser-based visual checks, and unified review dashboards. It is designed to expose what changed and how it was verified while leaving fix and ship decisions to the human.
defaultPrompt: Run ShipGuard on my current diff.
Simulate the process behavior for this change.
Review visual regressions for impacted routes.
